where: calc.js · D3 A per weapon, D3 S per wound roll, dmgCap
why: attackOnce now rolls aDice inside the per-model loop, so each weapon gets its own roll (02.02.03 Random Attacks), and rolls sDice for each hit at its wound roll (Other Random Characteristics, 'each time that characteristic is required'). wrS uses woundNeed(Sx, T) and the same −1 for 'S greater than T' as plan(); tm and T are in scope. Re-rolls (rrWound, fishW, the re-roll of one wound) reuse that hit's Sx. The averages are unchanged, as they must be. Hand-checked: 10 models with +D3 A, sd of the attacks √(10 × 2/3) = 2.58; 60 hits at S3+D3 vs T4, p = 11/18 for each, sd √(60 × 11/18 × 7/18) = 3.78. Both new calc-test cases are right. dmgCap now uses pd for normal damage and pd0 for [DEVASTATING WOUNDS] mortals (capN/capM likewise), consistent with dN/dM. The header comments and the working texts say 'for each weapon' / 'for each attack'.

Hand-worked, with a re-roll of one Hit roll and one attack at 4+ per weapon. The most valuable weapon (cannon) is resolved first and takes the re-roll on its miss, 1/2. The pistol takes it only when the cannon hit and the pistol missed, 1/2 × 1/2 = 1/4. Per unit, 3 models: used when any of the 3 misses, 1 − (1/2)³ = 7/8, not 3 × 1/2. The lowest critical value wins: toMod([6,5,6]) gives 5. Command Re-roll: the re-rolls used in a step, summed over all weapons, are > 0 and ≤ 1. Both the D3 sd cases are right (see calc.js). 371/371 pass. The cases for the Doctrina both-pill, Code Chivalric pool = 'selected' and the other-units stratagem are checks on the Damage tab, and they match the words.
